messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unfolds a map of the ruined royal city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept hilltop overlooking a shattered skyline of broken towers and torn banners; an ink-stained map flaps in the wind across a flat stone.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of a trap inside the walls.
scenes.visual_description: A battered oil lamp hovers beside the map, its single flame-eye casting a long warning shadow across the parchment.

scenes.caption: The tin fox is wound up for scouting.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with blue glass eyes sits on the stone while a brass key in its tail turns; gears tick under moonlight.

scenes.caption: The glass diver arrives through a cracked window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet steps out of a broken pane of glass on a ruined wall, coat shimmering with reflected city lights.

scenes.caption: The team approaches the towering castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: Massive iron gates loom over the four companions, half-collapsed, with chains snaking across cracked flagstones.

scenes.caption: The tin fox slips between the bars to scout ahead.
scenes.visual_description: The clockwork fox squeezes between rusted bars, tail-key still ticking, casting a tiny shadow on the courtyard beyond.

scenes.caption: A cursed tower glows green on the horizon.
scenes.visual_description: An impossibly tall tower leans against the night sky, sickly green light spilling from arrow slits onto the rubble below.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp deciphers a rumor of a great beast.
scenes.visual_description: The lamp hovers over a torn poster nailed to a charred door, its flame-eye narrowed; scales and claw marks are scratched into the wood.

scenes.caption: Tattered royal banners flutter above an empty plaza.
scenes.visual_description: Faded crimson banners drape from broken poles over a cracked fountain; the glass diver passes beneath them, reflected in every shard.

scenes.caption: Frightened faces peer from shuttered windows.
scenes.visual_description: Pale faces glimpse from behind broken shutters as Mara raises an open hand in reassurance, the lamp glowing softly beside her.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols march down the avenue.
scenes.visual_description: Heavy boots and pike-shafts fill the cobblestone street in silhouette; the tin fox flattens behind a barrel, blue eyes dimming.

scenes.caption: They find the sleeping tax collector blocking a stairway.
scenes.visual_description: A round official snores atop a marble step, head pillowed on a ledger, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves and cheek.

scenes.caption: Mara stamps her own forged pass to slip past.
scenes.visual_description: Mara presses a brass seal onto parchment while the official drools obliviously; the lamp tilts its flame-eye in amusement.

scenes.caption: A magic door blooms with shifting runes.
scenes.visual_description: An archway of dark stone pulses with rotating glyphs of silver light; the glass diver presses a gloved palm against the surface.

scenes.caption: The glass diver dives through a tall mirror.
scenes.visual_description: The diver plunges headfirst into a rippling mirror set in a ruined hall, coat trailing reflected lanterns like underwater stars.

scenes.caption: They emerge with the captive in a hidden vault.
scenes.visual_description: Inside a vaulted chamber lit by the lamp, the diver helps a freed captive to stand while the tin fox keeps watch at the door.

scenes.caption: The team races toward the long stone bridge.
scenes.visual_description: A narrow bridge stretches over a misty chasm, torches flaring behind; Mara leads, compass swinging, fox sprinting at her heels.

scenes.caption: They escape across the bridge at dawn.
scenes.visual_description: Pink light breaks over the ruined skyline behind them as the companions cross the far end of the bridge, the lamp's eye finally closing.
